params.body:
Five changes to the site, one commit each on the workbench branch (squashed into one commit here by the gateway). The Studio counterpart is the pull request on schoutteet-sanity with the same branch name.

## 1. Home hero: lighter
- The photo was under a dark veil from edge to edge. From `lg` on, the shade now sits only behind the text side and has faded out by 85% of the width. Below `lg` the text covers the photo, so there is an even veil (brand-900 at 60%).
- The orange eyebrow ("Sinds 1970") was 3.75:1 on the photo, under AA. It is now white with an orange bar before it.
- Measured against the brightest 5% of the photo behind each line, at 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 px: eyebrow 6.8 to 13.5, title 6.9 to 10.6, intro 5.3 to 8.7. All pass AA.

## 2. Company details from Sanity
- New `App\Site\Company`: name, tagline, address, country, phone, fax, e-mail and WhatsApp from `siteSettings.company`, field by field over built-in values. Used by the header, footer, contact page, privacy page, map, vehicle page, services pages, the AutoDealer JSON-LD and `/go/whatsapp`.
- Numbers are shown as entered. `tel:` links and JSON-LD use E.164. An emptied fax disappears. An empty WhatsApp number falls back to the phone.
- The address forms send to stays in config: `MAIL_FORM_RECIPIENT`, default info@schoutteet.com.
- Built-in Monday to Friday opening time: 07:30 (was 08:00).

## 3. Services: photo gallery instead of "Zo verloopt het"
- The three-step block is gone (template and built-in texts). The steps stay in Sanity, unused.
- Each service shows `service.photos`: the first photo wide, the rest as thumbnails. The old single `service.image` is shown first until the migration script has moved it.
- Every photo is a link to the large version, so it works without JavaScript. With JavaScript it opens in a lightbox (`resources/js/gallery.js`, no library, CSP-safe):
  - a native modal `<dialog>` with previous/next, a counter and arrow keys
  - swipe on a phone
  - Esc, the close button or a click beside the photo closes it
  - focus stays inside and returns to the photo that opened it
  - one photo: no previous/next and no counter
- The contact line under each service lost its middots, and "Alle diensten" lost its arrow.

## 4. Sell your vehicle: call, mail or WhatsApp
- The 14-field taxation form is replaced by three large buttons:
  - call
  - mail, which opens with the questions already in the mail
  - WhatsApp, which opens with "Hallo, ik wil een voertuig verkopen."
- Beside them: what helps to value a vehicle (`sellPage.checklist`). Below: a short form with name, phone or e-mail, a message and optional photos.
- Lead tracking:
  - Each button is recorded as a `taxatie` lead (the ping beacon for call and mail, the `/go/whatsapp?voor=verkopen` redirect for WhatsApp).
  - After consent, a click sends GA4 `generate_lead` and the Ads request conversion instead of the phone or WhatsApp conversion, so one click is one conversion.
  - A click leaves no `lead_event` for the next page.
  - Phone and WhatsApp links elsewhere are unchanged.
- The WhatsApp button uses `whatsapp-dark`: white on the lighter green is 3.1:1.

## 5. Categories: Brandweer and Personenwagens
- Fire engines never reached Brandweer: their body type ("Feuerwehrfahrzeug", untranslated in the DMS) has an id mapped to Vrachtwagen.
  - The mapping now first looks for a word in any of a vehicle's body types (`categories.body_type_words`). A second body type such as unimog no longer hides a fire engine.
  - The label is shown as "brandweerwagen".
- DMS branch 1 (PKW) now wins over the body type (`categories.branch_first`).
- "Auto" is renamed "Personenwagen" (Personenwagens):
  - `/voertuigen/auto` redirects with a 301, and the old site's car URLs follow.
  - A migration renames the stored values. The scrape source maps the old name on read.
- Both categories show in the menu, home tiles, listing bar and sitemap, in five languages. Like every category, they are hidden while empty.
- `vehicles:import` ends with a table of available vehicles per category, before and after the run.
- Home tiles: three per row on a phone instead of four, so Aanhangwagens, Brandweerwagens and Personenwagens fit their tile.

Staging before this change (2,628 available):

| Category | Before | Expected after the first import |
|---|---|---|
| Vrachtwagen | 892 | about 789 |
| Brandweer | 0 | about 103 |
| Personenwagen (was Auto) | 0 | 0 |

- 103 vehicles on staging have the body type "Feuerwehrfahrzeug". The DMS's own fire page counts 98.
- The DMS has no passenger cars today.
- The other categories don't change: Bovenbouwen 580, Kipwagen 263, Aanhangwagen 219, Oplegger 211, Kraan 182, Trekker 100, Onderdelen 88, Bouwmachines 73, Betonmixer 20.

## Checks
- `php artisan test`: 82 passed. Pint is clean.
- Gallery, lightbox and the sell-page tracking were checked in headless Chromium at 1440 and 390.

## After merge
1. `php artisan migrate`, for the Auto to Personenwagen rename.
2. Deploy the Studio from the schoutteet-sanity pull request.
3. Run the three Sanity scripts: company details and hours, service photos, sell page. Each script does a dry run first and needs `--apply` with an Editor token to write.
4. The next hourly import recategorises the stock and prints the before/after table.

## Not in this change
- Em dashes in page titles.
- The arrows after "Alle voertuigen" and "Alle diensten" in the mobile menu.
- The other WhatsApp buttons still use the lighter green.
params.title: Lighter hero, company details from Sanity, service gallery, simpler sell page, Brandweer and Personenwagens
